description: A static auth token cached by one test class is reused, expired, by another under parallel execution.
howSeeded: Restored the static token cache in AuthSupport and enabled parallel=classes in the TestNG suite.
decidingEvidence: The test source showing a static token field populated by one test class and reused by another under parallel execution.
twinAxis: Also state left behind by an earlier test, but the stale thing is the suite's own static field, so ownership keeps it in TEST_CODE_DEFECT.
